## Activity

During April 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 93 captures. This report summarises the site’s activity for the month and highlights the main points arising from image review and grading. The recorded activity provides a clear basis for monitoring service delivery and identifying any operational issues that may require follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 8 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.6 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that faults can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements. Consistent recording of these issues will help distinguish equipment-related problems from other causes of reduced image quality.

## Grading

A total of 11 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 0. These results should continue to be reviewed through routine site monitoring, with attention given to image quality and the timely escalation of any technical concerns. The site team should maintain accurate records and ensure that recurring camera issues are included in service desk reports.
